name: ChocoLlama-Bench
description: A general-purpose evaluation suite assembled for the ChocoLlama model family that measures model performance across multiple common LM tasks (e.g., reasoning, knowledge, and code). It is intended to provide a compact, comparative view of model strengths and weaknesses on text-centric tasks.
reputation: Community-created benchmark associated with the ChocoLlama project; modest adoption among model developers and enthusiasts.
